conviction_note: The numbers are new (no trading update, no profit warning) and there is no guide to change, so abs_move is set at 6.0, between this name's own last eight results days (median about 4.7%, range -7.0 to +10.2) and the European 7% base. p_up is 40 because GfK's Swedish panel, published around 2 November, shows the market at -0.1% in Q3 after +5.9% in Q2. findings.finding: GfK's Swedish optical panel shows the market flat in Q3 2026 (total SEK 3,115m against 3,118m; spectacles -0.1%) after +5.9% in Q2. The two-year stack fell from about 17.7% to about 13.2%, so this is a real slowdown and not only the comp. Synsam has outgrown this panel by 1.8-3.0pp in each of the last three quarters, which puts its Sweden organic growth (nearly half of group sales, its highest-margin market) at about 2-3% against 8.9% in Q2. That contradicts the CEO's August statement that the Q2 trend was continuing into Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Organic growth is the line this stock trades on. Q1 2026 organic 5.6% (12.8% a year earlier) and the stock fell 7.0% on the day; Q2 2026 organic 9.8% with sales 2.4% over consensus and it rose 7.5%; Q4 2025 +10.2%; Q3 2025 (organic 12.4%, sales above consensus) +4.2%. Day moves from Finwire's table: https://www.placera.se/telegram/synsam-synsam-vantas-redovisa-447-miljoner-i-ebitda-modular-20261109
findings.original_quote: Optikmarknaden - Sverige Panelmarknaden - Kvartalsrapport. Trend jmf m föregående år, Värde SEK, Jul 26-Sep 26: GLASÖGON -0,1; KONTAKTLINSER 1,6. OPTIK TOTALT Värde MSEK: Jul 26-Sep 26 3.115 (Jul 25-Sep 25 file: 3.118). [Translation: Swedish optical market, panel market, quarterly report. Change on the prior year by value, Jul-Sep 2026: spectacles -0.1%, contact lenses +1.6%; total optical SEK 3,115m against 3,118m a year earlier.] CEO, 21 Aug: 'Vi såg det i andra kvartalet och det är ungefär samma trend vi ser också in i det tredje kvartalet' [We saw it in the second quarter and it is roughly the same trend we are also seeing into the third quarter]
findings.why_not_priced: This is partly priced: Nordea read it ('optikmarknaden krympte något') and still models Sweden LFL +3% and group sales +8%. But the Modular consensus is above Nordea at +8.9% reported, which leaves about 6.6% organic and needs about 10% outside Sweden. The stock also rose about 6% (56.3 to 59.5) in the sessions after the file went up on 2 November. If the market had absorbed a flat Swedish market against the CEO's 'same trend in Q3', the run-up would have stalled and consensus would have been trimmed towards Nordea. The data is an image-only PDF on a trade-association site with no wire copy, which is why no English source carries it.
findings.independence: Nordea's note independently says the Swedish optical market shrank slightly in Q3: https://www.placera.se/telegram/synsam-nordea-upprepar-behall-for-synsam-vantas-vaxa-trots-svag-svensk-optikmarknad-20261106. The tough comp is in Synsam's own Q3 2025 report (Sweden organic 15.1%): https://www.inderes.se/en/releases/synsam-groups-q3-report-2025

findings.finding: NOK averaged 7.8% stronger against SEK in Q3 2026 than in Q3 2025 (EUR -0.1%, DKK -0.3%). With Norway about 30% of sales (backed out from the Q1 and Q2 gaps between reported and organic growth), that adds about +2.3pp of translation to reported growth, so consensus at +8.9% reported needs only about 6.6% organic.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None isolated. Q1 2026 reported 3.8% against organic 5.6% (FX -1.8pp) and Q2 reported 11.3% against organic 9.8% (FX +1.5pp); the stock traded on organic growth both times.
findings.why_not_priced: Exchange rates are public and analysts probably model them, which is why this is small. It matters for the bar: it means the reported-sales headline the wire will compare against 1,885 gets about SEK 40m of help that has nothing to do with Sweden.
findings.independence: The reported-versus-organic gaps in Synsam's Q1 and Q2 2026 reports fit the same Norway weight: https://news.cision.com/synsam-group/r/synsam-group-s-q1-report-2026,c4346254 and https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bbd59f69b313424513af47c2698b1dafd&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: Outside Sweden the Q3 2025 comps are much harder than Q2's: Norway 12.3% and Finland 26.1% organic in Q3 2025, against a group 9.1% in Q2 2025. Consensus needs about 10% organic outside Sweden, which is Q2's pace on easier comps. Denmark's 2.3% comp and the returns-handling change (+3.9pp of growth in Q2) only partly offset this.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 was the last quarter on a 12%+ comp (12.8%): organic growth came in at 5.6% and the stock fell 7.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: The comps are public, so this is mostly priced and kept small. A two-year stack held at Q2's 18.9% gives group organic of about 6.5%, roughly what consensus implies, so the comp alone is near neutral. It leans negative only if the Swedish slowdown also shows up in Norway, and no Norwegian market series could be reached to check that.

baseline_tension: The evidence agrees with the sealed lean (-0.645, all of it run-up) and cuts against the +12.9% 20-day run-up, which has raised the bar into a quarter where the home market went flat. Because the lean is only the run-up, agreeing with it adds little that the free control lacks.
language_note: The load-bearing datum, GfK's Swedish optical panel for Q3 2026 (Optikbranschen, 'Sverige Panelmarknaden', spectacles -0.1%), exists only as an image-only Swedish PDF on the trade association's site. No English source carries it.

Nordea's preview with the Sweden LFL +3% estimate and the 'optikmarknaden krympte något' remark, the Modular consensus table with the last eight report-day moves, and the CEO's 'samma trend ... in i det tredje kvartalet' quote all came from Swedish Finwire and Direkt wire copy on Placera. The English sources found only the issuer's bilingual releases.
The issuer's own releases (Q2 report, Q3 invitation, buyback notices) are published in English and Swedish at once and carry nothing different.
lessons_applied: 'You were right about the number and too small about the move' and the 7% base for new numbers: abs_move_pct raised from 5.5 to 6.0. The name's own eight observed results days (median about 4.7%, Q4 2025 +10.2%) and the absence of a guide keep it below 7.

'Understatement is the hunters' systematic error' plus 'net of the rest of the company': the Swedish-market finding goes from -1.5 to -2.0 (range widened to -4.5). Sweden is nearly half of sales and the highest-margin segment, and the last organic shortfall (Q1 2026) moved the stock -7.0%. The rest of the company (about 10% organic needed outside Sweden) is already netted in the third finding. p_up goes from 42 to 40 for the same reason, applied once.
'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series': confirmed that the broad Swedish GfK panel outranks the CEO's August verbal trend comment and the Fielmann read-across, which is rejected.
